tasks.short: Develop and implement individual support strategies

steps.what: Develop and implement strategies responsive to students with different disabilities

tasks.design: Keep strategy development and implementation with the teacher. Existing {DOCS} can hold agreed plans, but drafting a plan does not establish whether a strategy fits a child.
tasks.previous_blocker: Response depends on individual communication, development and classroom context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is assumed for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising distress and adapting support during activity.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher builds trust and observes responses directly.

evidence.claim: Individual strategy choice and classroom implementation remain contextual professional work; no saving is estimated.

assumptions: Planning and implementation are both retained in the full baseline.
No structured disability or response classification is produced automatically.
Use existing documents where needed; no new system.
No incremental upkeep because the process is unchanged.
unknowns: Existing individual plans and specialist availability
research_questions: Which adaptations require the most classroom adjustment?

incremental.description: Unchanged process has no new maintenance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net saving 0%; no displaced work is evidenced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Communicate nonverbally with children and adapt encouragement to their responses

tasks.design: Keep nonverbal communication with the teacher. {DOCS} may describe agreed communication preferences elsewhere, but the live interaction remains fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Meaning depends on the child and the trusted relationship.
tasks.enabler_now: No system substitutes for this interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Reading subtle signals without making unwarranted assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Responsive presence and familiarity with each child.

evidence.claim: Direct nonverbal encouragement has no identified administrative component to remove here.

assumptions: Only the direct interaction is in scope.
No automatic emotion or comfort flags are assumed.
Existing communication plans suffice; no new application.
No changed process means no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: How do staff learn each child's preferred communication?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; all direct interaction remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture student observations, source references and locally required record fields
Assemble records and flag missing configured fields without inventing content
Check accurate records, resolve omissions and accept the exact record version

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OTHER} pupil record system to assemble verified fields and show omissions. The teacher captures observations and verifies the record before saving an accepted version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transcription and checks across record sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil record systems already support pupil records and development plans.
tasks.still_hard: Determining whether observations are accurate and the local requirements are met.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher separates observed facts from interpretations.

reach.learn: Which fields are required and who may access them

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and development plans; this supports a native record workflow, not automated educational judgement.
The proposed reduction in repeated record assembly is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing pupil record system; prefer native forms and validation.

In s1 the teacher produces student identity, observation date, author, factual text, source and plan reference, and checks the required-field list supplied by the school administrator. Capture is counted in the 40% step; absent fields return for manual completion.
The school administrator maintains the field list and access rules; 4 other-role hours per 100 baseline hours are counted as incremental work.
Savings apply only where assembly is currently repeated manually; no diagnostic labels or inferred progress are generated.
unknowns: Required record fields and retention rules
research_questions: How much record time is duplicate assembly after observation capture?

incremental.description: Template checks and exception handling beyond routine review

approvals.approved_version: Exact student identity, dated observation text, author, sources and plan references; any change requires another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65, gross=35%; minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 28%. Conservative range 0-10% allows existing automation and extensive corrections; unmeasured E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Teach socially acceptable behavior through appropriate modelling and positive reinforcement

tasks.design: Retain direct teaching and reinforcement with the teacher. {DOCS} can hold an existing support plan, while responsive teaching remains fully human time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Children respond differently to social situations and reinforcement.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a proportionate response that supports dignity and learning.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher models behaviour and repairs misunderstandings in context.

evidence.claim: Direct social teaching remains contextual work; a separate clerical baseline is not established.

assumptions: This task covers direct teaching, not the separately counted student records.
No automatic behaviour, emotion or compliance scores are assumed.
Use existing support plans without a new application.
No incremental upkeep because the workflow is unchanged.
research_questions: Which classroom situations need individual adaptations?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0%. No direct teaching time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Responsive preschool special education with reliable records
reach: Coordinate adaptations with families and specialists
role.ambitious_version: More reliable records support teaching decisions while direct relationships remain central.
